name: Marcus Pike
bio: Forty years of Blue Note pressings in a spare room. Has opinions about run-out grooves.

notes.note: Small rooms, late sets, the count-in left in. If you can hear the bassist breathe, it made the cut.
Philadelphia to Portland by way of every basement with a piano in it. Mostly what I play a friend who says they do not like jazz.
Ballads only. I put this together for a friend who couldn't sleep and it has outlived the insomnia.
